_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`. Dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. `distribution.active: "binary"` is what makes the Agent install a real per-platform binary instead of showing the tool as LOCAL — the archives are built by .github/workflows/build-executa-binaries.yml and downloaded into ./dist by scripts/download-binaries.ps1 before publishing. Run `anna-app dev` from the app root to use the local Python copy (profile `local`), e.g. `anna-app executa publish --profile local` if you ever need to push the dev-only flavour.
